reasons: The selector sets otel_metric_type="gauge", but postgresql.tup_deleted is a monotonic sum and the dataset only holds sum, so the query would match no series.
The $db template variable (tag prefix db, default *) is dropped. It should become postgresql_database_name=~"$db", the observed label, not db_namespace, which is absent.
The $host template variable (tag prefix host, default *) is dropped. It should become host_name=~"$host", the observed label, so the host filter is missing and the series set is wrong.

Grouping by db maps to postgresql_database_name, which is observed, so the by clause is correct. The avg aggregation and the rate() on a monotonic sum are acceptable. The $scope variable has no prefix and is correctly dropped.
Converting a Datadog count to a per-second rate changes the unit to rows/s; a note on this would help, but it is not the blocking issue.
